The booking sites at Fort Lauderdale hotels

52 sites, 15 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: Booking.com at 17, Hotels.com at 14, the hotel's own site at 14, Expedia.com at 12 and Priceline at 12. Fewest sites: Sheraton Suites Fort Lauderdale at Cypress Creek (5); most: Hyatt Place Fort Lauderdale Cruise Port & Convention Center (28).

Booking.com was lowest at none of its 17, and 5%+ above another site at 12. Hotels.com was lowest at Snooze Hotel of its 14, and 5%+ above another site at 9. Expedia.com was lowest at 4 of its 12, and 5%+ above another site at 6.

The hotel's own site, at 14 of the 17: lowest at none, a median 14% above the lowest site. Nearest: Four Seasons Hotel And Residences Fort Lauderdale, $759 against $757 on Expedia.com. Farthest: Ocean Manor Beach Resort, $206 against $141 on Evendo.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Super.com at 4, Evendo at 2, Traveluro at 2, Agoda at 1, Billabook.com at 1, Etrip.net at 1, goseek.com at 1, Kiwi.com at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them (ties count for each). All cities: which booking site was lowest most often.

Google's free cancellation label was on a site's lowest listing at 8 of the 17, on the lowest price at 3 (Plaza Hotel Fort Lauderdale, Snooze Hotel and Sheraton Suites Fort Lauderdale at Cypress Creek); at the other 5 it cost a median $14 (22%) more. Is it worth it?

A lower price may be a smaller room or a non-refundable rate.

Taxes and fees in Fort Lauderdale

They added a median of 12.9% ($12 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It was 12.0% to 13.6% at all 9 hotels, from Sea Club Resort to Omni Fort Lauderdale Hotel: no flat nightly fee on top. Whether a resort fee was inside the before-tax price, our data cannot tell. The 8 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: hotel booking fees explained.

Questions about Fort Lauderdale hotel prices

How much is a hotel in Fort Lauderdale?

$112 a night all-in at the median (Sep 29, 2026 prices), from $53 at Sea Club Resort to $431 at Omni Fort Lauderdale Hotel.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in Fort Lauderdale?

No: these prices come from a few Fort Lauderdale dates, not a season.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Fort Lauderdale hotels?

Below the going rate, most often Super.com (4 hotels) and Evendo and Traveluro (2 hotels each). The hotel's own site: lowest at none of 14.

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 29, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price.
